canonical_rule: sha256(json.dumps(record minus record_sha256, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')).encode('utf-8'))
plan_digest_rule: guard file_sha256: sha256 of UTF-8 text with CRLF/CR normalized to LF; raw blob digest reported alongside

stamps.record_sha256_recomputed: MEASURED (recomputed in this script from ledger blob at pin)
stamps.acceptance_commit: MEASURED (git log --reverse -S<record_sha256> <pin> -- ledger; first/oldest hit). Note: a second hit on the next accepting commit is expected because that commit adds the same digest again as previous_record_sha256 (occurrence count 1->2).
stamps.plan_at_acceptance_sha256_*: MEASURED (git show <acceptance_commit>:plan; sha256 raw and normalized)
stamps.ledger_lines[*].line_sha256: MEASURED (sha256 of line bytes, trailing CR/LF stripped, from ledger blob at pin)
stamps.wall_s_INHERITED_under_load: INHERITED (shared box under load; not a benchmark)
stamps.plan_revision labels in config: INHERITED (from preruling_config.json; cross-checked by plan_header_at_pin which is MEASURED)
